zh: 修复 @创建声音 等内置工具集调用时因缺少 preview() 导致的「toolset.preview is not a function」报错，并在运行器与额外工具调度中增加安全兜底。
在对话系统提示中注入当前服务器时间与时区，优化微信历史查询日期计算与长输出分段读取指引。
将审批推送抽屉样式前缀重构为 .ainbox-*，避免与首页对话区域样式名冲突。
en: Fixed the 'toolset.preview is not a function' error when calling @voice-creator and added defensive preview() guards in the agent run manager and extra-tools dispatcher.
Injected the current server timestamp into chat system prompts and refined wechat-vault relative-date and truncated-output instructions.
Namespaced approval-inbox CSS classes from .ai-* to .ainbox-* to prevent stylesheet collisions with home chat UI.
